metadata.name: AviationEmergencyProceduresOntology
metadata.description: A structured representation of aviation emergency procedures, enabling effective querying and retrieval of information related to emergency landings, pilot actions, and associated hazards.
metadata.generated_from: Manager Plan and Domain Expert Artifact

classes.name: EmergencyProcedure
classes.description: A structured set of actions to be taken during an aviation emergency.

attributes.name: procedure_name
attributes.description: The name of the emergency procedure.

classes.name: ProcedureStep
classes.description: An individual step within an emergency procedure, detailing specific actions to be taken.

attributes.name: step_order

attributes.name: action_text
attributes.description: Text describing the action to be taken in this step.

attributes.name: step_type

classes.name: Warning
classes.description: A notification regarding potential hazards or risks during flight operations.

classes.name: SourceEvidence
classes.description: Documentation or data that supports the procedures and actions taken during emergencies.

attributes.name: evidence_source
attributes.description: The source from which the evidence is derived.

classes.name: TriggerCondition
classes.description: Conditions that necessitate the execution of an emergency procedure.

classes.name: FlightPhase

classes.name: AircraftState
classes.description: The operational status of the aircraft during an emergency.

attributes.name: aircraft_condition

classes.name: AircraftSystem
classes.description: Components of the aircraft that may be affected during emergencies.

attributes.name: system_name

classes.name: EmergencyEvent
classes.description: An occurrence that triggers the need for emergency procedures.

attributes.name: pilot_decision

validation_rules.rule: Each ProcedureStep must have a unique step_order within its EmergencyProcedure.
An EmergencyProcedure must have at least one ProcedureStep.
Each Hazard must be linked to at least one EmergencyProcedure.
